text_block_list.text:
A piece of fan mail arrived for Special 
Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm so, so happy! I'll be sure to treasure 
this letter and read it carefully!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'll write a reply to the letter, 
and then, and then...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of that child who's cheering 
for me, I have to work way, waaaay 
harder... right?!

Special Week's motivation seemed to rise 
with the support from her fans.
